title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.43: Fixed an error when hovering a card in the second combat after the Planned tooltip icon had been shown - the icon was cached across room transitions, and the game unloads room art between rooms, so the tooltip was left pointing at a freed texture. The Understudy timeline portraits could go the same way and are fixed too.
